links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT-4 TKA patient education materials versus human-generated materials
links.effect: ChatGPT-4 PEMs had significantly higher reading grade level and lower reading ease score than human-generated PEMs (p < 0.001); no difference in DISCERN reliability and quality.
links.quote: ChatGPT-4 PEMs demonstrated a significantly higher reading grade level and lower reading ease score compared to human-generated PEMs < 0.001.

screen.reason: Empirical comparison of ChatGPT-4 generated patient education materials versus human-generated materials using readability scores and DISCERN criteria; does not test a specific deployment safeguard or intervention.
